name: interaction_3d
title: 3D interactables: volumes, pickups, trigger volumes
summary: Area3D interactables in the "interactable" group with interact(actor) and an `interacted` signal, a one-shot bobbing pickup, and a trigger volume. third_person_controller's probe drives them.
usage: Anything usable is an Area3D with scripts/interactable.gd (or pickup.gd) and a CollisionShape3D. Connect `interacted` in the editor, or subclass and override _on_interact. The third_person_controller kit's InteractRange finds the nearest one and calls interact(actor) on the interact action.
